method: read-only source sweep of lib/* + ceremony CLIs + tests (Explore agent, very thorough)

findings.title: Ceremony CLI ledger format schema-invalid and invisible to lib/output-cost
findings.impact: mixed formats can turn unknown spend into 0 credits for any lib-side consumer
findings.recommendedAction: align CLI ledger to lib field names + validate; single format

findings.title: Live ledger hand-edited outside code paths; stale top-level totals
findings.evidence: projects/phase1g12-case-a/budget/ledger.json header creditsObserved=43 vs totals 50; previousState field written by no code
findings.impact: canonical spend state mutated outside auditable code
findings.recommendedAction: explicit reconcile subcommand through one code path; drop stale header

findings.title: Retry reservation silently dropped on attemptId ledger collision (B); C/D never append reservation
findings.evidence: run-case-b.js:99 dedupe by attemptId; repair path :319-322 same attemptId; run-case-c.js:385-400 / run-case-d.js:427-442 asymmetric
findings.impact: remainingBudget overstated during in-flight retry
findings.recommendedAction: key entries by (attemptId,kind); append reservation in C/D like B

findings.title: Unknown submit state contributes 0 to remaining budget
findings.evidence: lib/output-cost/budget.js:100-103,267-271; authorize* and checkHardStop never check totals.unknown
findings.impact: gate sees full budget while an unknown-cost submit is in flight
findings.recommendedAction: unknown>0 on the unit → REVIEW_REQUIRED, never full budget

findings.title: applyManualOverride leaves stale derived properties (downgrade keeps VIDEO caps → validator fails; upgrade keeps referenceStrategy NONE)
findings.impact: overridden decisions validation-invalid or lose identity guidance
findings.recommendedAction: re-derive referenceStrategy/requiredCapabilities/requiredAssetRoles from selected strategy + continuity signals; validator judges effectiveOutputType

findings.title: persistDecision selection-restore keeps new renderMode with old effectiveOutputType
findings.impact: persisted artifact not renderer-reproducible from structured fields
findings.recommendedAction: same recompute as A-5 or refuse incompatible merge

findings.title: applyModelOverride does not recompute cost; units ignore effectiveModel
findings.impact: budget priced for recommended model after operator override
findings.recommendedAction: units resolve effectiveModel ?? selectedModel ?? recommended; costEstimate STALE on override

findings.title: registerAsset never persists asset bytes (data loss; state ownership)
findings.evidence: lib/asset-library/registry.js:81,125-143; ceremony CLIs pass bytes without relativePath
findings.impact: assetId lineage dangles if downloads/ cleaned; canonical media not core-owned
findings.recommendedAction: persist bytes via writeArtifactAtomic when relativePath absent

findings.title: Case D cross-shot QA + finalize PASS-by-construction; B5/B6/D6 hardcoded
findings.impact: continuity/correlation evidence cannot block a READY verdict
findings.recommendedAction: derive rows from machine-readable records + computed ambiguity check

findings.title: Regression gaps: no override-preserves-VEO_REFERENCE test; no correlation-ambiguity-cannot-become-READY test; no remainingBudget-unknown test
findings.impact: fixes not pinned
findings.recommendedAction: add the three tests

findings.title: Ceremony wjson bypasses atomic artifact store
findings.impact: crash can leave truncated JSON
findings.recommendedAction: route through writeArtifactAtomic

findings.title: Correlation submitAtApprox hardcoded; cited D_SUBMIT_EVIDENCE events emitted only by hand
findings.impact: stale submit time reproduced for new attempts
findings.recommendedAction: read from ceremony log / explicit arg; emit events in code

findings.title: Structural: declared video dimension expectation silently NOT_APPLICABLE when unobservable
findings.impact: dimension mismatch can be missed on videos
findings.recommendedAction: UNKNOWN/BLOCKER when expectation declared but unobservable

findings.title: compileForDecision compiles every package twice (persisted ≠ validated)
findings.impact: efficiency + skew
findings.recommendedAction: compile once

findings.title: Generation-unit/correlation identity gaps: no attemptId/promptVersion/referenceIds/instructionsVersion on units; no GenerationJob artifact; attempt ids break at >=10
findings.impact: identity fragmented across artifacts
findings.recommendedAction: extend unit + correlation record fields (bridge submit-issued covers the live path)

findings.title: continuity.js dead ternary + spurious UNKNOWNs for absent expectations
findings.impact: inflated unknownLayers
findings.recommendedAction: fix ternary; NOT_APPLICABLE for absent expectations

findings.title: Aggregate recommendation ignores WARNING-severity failures
findings.impact: review-required asset gets NONE recommendation
findings.recommendedAction: inspect warningLayers too

findings.title: Reserved + observed double-count on entries carrying both (lib)
findings.impact: conservative overblock
findings.recommendedAction: document semantics; release on reconcile

findings.title: Unlock→mutate→lock idempotency loop destroys lock history
findings.impact: lock provenance lost on re-run; transient unlock window
findings.recommendedAction: no-op when already locked with same reason

findings.title: Structural input precedence: bytes vs filePath can diverge silently
findings.impact: mixed-evidence QA if caller passes stale bytes
findings.recommendedAction: document; prefer probe consistently

clean: path traversal (artifact-store resolveProjectPath blocks .. and absolute; sanitizeFilename)
secret persistence (no cookies/tokens in artifacts; case-result rejects embedding)
registry integrity (hash dedup idempotent, IMMUTABLE_FIELDS, lock gate, cycle-safe lineage)
QA gate policy (stale/hash-drift/mismatch/non-READY all block; critical UNKNOWN cannot pass)
lib budget policy (UNKNOWN cost never APPROVED; conflict/stale blocked; lineage mandatory; observation idempotent)
provider boundary in decisions (model names/prices forbidden in canonical text)
applyModelOverride re-validates against stored requirement (no lost caps; gap is cost staleness A-7)
